name: x12-opp-died
about: v192: The HexIron Ir-Maides (26RBS03-X12) LV1-2 (Your Attack Step) (Once Per Turn): 'When opposing 2000 BP or less Spirits are destroyed, refresh this Spirit' = new trigger OPP_DIED (any cause; evQ OPP_DIED carries ctx.bp = the destroyed Spirit's BP when destroyed, so match.bpLe filters on that). LV2 (Your Attack Step): when your Wailwraith/Hexcraft family Spirit is blocked, -4000 BP to an opposing blocking Spirit and destroy it at 0 = ALLY_BLOCKED + BP_MINUS {n:4000, zeroDestroy, blockerOnly}.
